theme_strategy.visual_mood: Dark Obsidian backgrounds, Electric Lime data points, Signal Red alerts. Think 'Moneyball' meets 'Bloomberg Terminal'.

rules: Headings must be UPPERCASE to convey authority.
All numerical data (odds, probabilities, ROI) MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Use 'tracking-tighter' for large numbers to keep them compact.

strategies: Use 'border-collapse' style layouts for data tables.
Avoid large gaps in dashboard views; density is key for analytics.
Use 'h-full' on grid children to ensure uniform height.

buttons.primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black hover:bg-[#B3E600] rounded-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-sm h-10 px-6
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1E1E1E] text-white hover:bg-[#2A2A2A] border border-[#333] rounded-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-sm h-10 px-6
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-[#A1A1AA] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs

cards.base: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#27272A] rounded-none p-0 relative overflow-hidden
cards.header: px-4 py-3 border-b border-[#27272A] flex justify-between items-center bg-[#0F0F0F]

inputs.base: bg-[#050505] border border-[#27272A] text-white placeholder:text-[#52525B] focus:border-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] rounded-none h-10

badges.live: bg-[#FF2E2E] text-white px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest animate-pulse
badges.value: bg-[#CCFF00]/10 text-[#CCFF00] border border-[#CCFF00]/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest
badges.league: bg-[#27272A] text-[#A1A1AA] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider

navigation.sidebar_item: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-[#A1A1AA] hover:text-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#CCFF00]/5 transition-colors border-l-2 border-transparent hover:border-[#CCFF00]

visual_enhancers.surface_style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Make the grid visible.
effects: Scanlines: overlay 'bg-[linear-gradient(rgba(18,16,16,0)_50%,rgba(0,0,0,0.25)_50%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,0,0,0.06),rgba(0,255,0,0.02),rgba(0,0,255,0.06))]' with 'z-50 pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 bg-[length:100%_2px,3px_100%]'
Noise: Add a subtle noise texture to the background using a fixed opacity layer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'recharts' for all charts. Style them to match the theme (hide grid lines, use neon strokes).
Implement a 'Sidebar' layout for the main dashboard.
Ensure the 'Value Bet' detector uses the '#CCFF00' color prominently to signal opportunity.
For the 'Combinadas' (Parlay) generator, use a 'shopping cart' style interface on the right side.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications: style them dark with neon borders.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors with subtle 1px borders.
Force 'dark' class on the html element in index.html or App.js.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers only.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
